description: A phase distortion: the audio is run through an allpass filter and the module flips back and forth between the filtered and unfiltered copies according to which of the two is larger at that instant

params.text: Sets the corner frequency of the allpass filter, 4Hz at the far left to about 20kHz at the far right
Sets how abruptly the module flips between the two copies, from a smeared blend at the far left to a hard switch at the far right
Feeds a highpassed copy of the output back into the input, none at the far left and almost total at the far right
Offsets one copy against the other before they are compared, -5V to 5V, which makes the flips sparser and coarser
In its upper position the flip rate is tied to the allpass corner frequency instead of being set on its own, which gives a steadier, more filter-like character
Shifts the allpass corner frequency by one octave per volt at the far ends of its travel, and by nothing at centre
Shifts the flip rate, and by nothing at centre
Shifts the resonance, and by nothing at centre
Shifts the bias, and by nothing at centre
Swaps which side of the comparison selects the filtered copy, so the same settings give the opposite texture

inputs.text: The control voltage for the allpass corner frequency; with nothing patched this jack reads the size of the incoming audio, so the filter tracks the sound's own loudness
The control voltage for the flip rate; with nothing patched this jack reads the size of the incoming audio
The control voltage for the resonance; with nothing patched this jack reads the size of the incoming audio
The control voltage for the bias; with nothing patched this jack reads the size of the incoming audio

outputs.text: The distorted audio, soft clipped at 10V
The flip signal itself, smoothed by the same filter that softens the flips, 0V on one copy and 10V on the other

notes: All four control voltage jacks are normalled to the size of the incoming audio, which is what NORMALLED CV IN means; an attenuverter turned up with nothing patched modulates from the sound
Everything follows the channel count of the audio input, so nothing runs with that jack empty

1V per octave · continuous · polyphonic
